argv: SELECT CASE WHEN d.file_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(d.file_id AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN d.string_pool_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(d.string_pool_id AS TEXT)) END AS "string_pool_id",CASE WHEN d.source_path IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(d.source_path AS TEXT)) END AS "source_path",CASE WHEN d.entry_name IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(d.entry_name AS TEXT)) END AS "entry_name" FROM dex_files d ORDER BY d.file_id
